notes.title: 🌊 Tides of Tomorrow - New Game Reveal
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Road 96 Community,[/h3]

We've been incredibly touched by your passion and enthusiasm for Road 96. Your support has meant the world to us, and we're thrilled to have shared that journey with you 🎉

Today, we're excited to unveil a new project that we've been pouring our hearts and souls into. While it's not Road 96, we believe it embodies the same spirit of creativity and storytelling that you've come to love from DigixArt.

[h5]We hope you will welcome and wishlist our new baby-project - Tides of Tomorrow 🌊[/h5]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2678080/Tides_of_Tomorrow/

[h3]Watch our reveal trailer![/h3]

[previewyoutube=yVjNGNZcqHQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]In Tides of Tomorrow your every choice matters. A deadly plastification is slowly killing all life, and it's up to you to find a cure, explore floating platforms, and navigate through various communities. But you won’t be alone! Your friends' and other players' decisions will directly impact your story, adding a thrilling layer of unpredictability.[/i]

We understand that change can be bittersweet, and we want to assure you that Road 96 holds a special place in our hearts. While we can't currently share any information about the sequel, the Road 96 universe is rich with stories waiting to be explored.

We hope you'll join us on this new adventure and continue to be a part of our growing community. Your feedback and support mean everything to us, and we can't wait to share more details with you soon.

[h5]Thank you for being amazing fans![/h5]

[h3]Warm regards,
DigixArt Studio[/h3]

notes.title: Road 96 Second Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Hitchhikers![/h2]

[h5][i]It is the second anniversary of our beloved Road 96! We want to thank you all for your unwavering love and immense support for our project ❤️ We want you to know that we’re deeply grateful and committed to continue to pour our hearts into developing our games, we have no intention of slowing down.[/i][/h5]

[h3]Physical Book Announcement![/h3]

We have a fantastic surprise for you! Well, hold onto your hats because the interactive book "Road 96: About a Girl" will be [u][b]RELEASED SOON[/b][/u] in a beautifully crafted [b]physical edition[/b].

The narrative of the book follows Zoe's journey after the events of Road 96: Mile 0 and Road 96. Ever wondered what happened to Zoe after leaving White Sands? The book sheds light on her journey, family, and struggles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/75ab07d88d229805c0eecbab62105cf68a6e0cf0.png[/img]

But that is not all! Did you miss our beloved characters? You will get the chance to encounter them all – cool and a bit crazy Stan and Mitch, stunning Sonya, dinosaur fan Jarod, talented boy Alex, warm-hearted Fanny, Papa Bear and maybe… even Kaito!

The book will remain interactive, allowing you to make choices at the end of each chapter and decide how the story will develop, making it fun to reread and uncover more details about Zoe and Petria!. 

[quote=author] [h5]If you're craving the tangible delight of a physical copy, it will be available soon on our [u][b][url=https://road96.com/]brand-new Website here[/url][/b][/u][/h5][/quote]

[h5]For those who cannot wait for the physical release and eager to explore the digital version of the e-book, simply follow this link: [/h5]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2322790/Road_96_Mile_0__About_a_Girl/

Picture decorating your shelf with this masterpiece, savoring the scent of freshly printed paper, and getting lost in its mesmerizing illustrations and captivating story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/286f52a23c8f07bb7b7ff622154e8833e794d438.png[/img]
[h3]New Website![/h3]

As you could notice, Road 96 had it is [u][b][url=https://road96.com/]own website road96.com[/url][/b][/u]! Here you can find all the cool stuff in the Road 96 franchise – from games and books to awesome merchandise! 

Check it out here! We think it looks cool :) What do you think? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/96fdbfea738e88c4a651ce119768b42c756e2af7.gif[/img]

[h5]We can't express enough how much your kind words and unwavering support mean to our team. Your support is truly inspiring and fueling us to keep our project moving forward! Stay tuned for more from our team. Rest assured, we are far from finished with the captivating universe of Road 96![/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/22a487119971271818535a8ad04c644cb998ad93.png[/img]

[h3]With endless gratitude, 
DigixArt Team[/h3]

notes.title: New Patch for Win 32
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there, amazing community!

[/h2]
We just wanted to say a big thank you to all of you who shared your feedback on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095340/Road_96_Mile_0/]Road 96: Mile 0[/url]. We're sorry to hear that some of you have been dealing with technical issues while playing the game.

We've been working hard to make things better! Today, we're excited to release a new patch for Win 32 version fixing multiple technical issues: 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue allowing the player to enter Zoe's Room before discussing with Kaito in Oasis Villas
[*] Fixed an issue affecting the shed’s lightbulb when tearing off the cables in Oasis Villas.
[*] Fixed an issue where Zoe’s voice clips would play instead of Kaito’s when using the seesaw in Oasis Villas.
[*] A save point was added when going from Oasis Villas to the final map in act II.
[*] Tweaked the tattoo minigame to prevent some issues affecting a small portion of players
[*] Fixed an issue where Colton could sometimes be heard repeating himself when pushing him on the swing.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the player to progress during the walkie-talkie discussion in Hideout
[*] Fixed an issue blocking the player if a ride replay was triggered during an after ride Hideout chapter
[*] Removed John floating in the Hideout
[*] Fixed an issue where John’s truck would sometimes appear floating in the air in the Hideout in act II.
[*] The location of the bouncing ball in the Hideout has been changed.
[*] Fixed a collider issue causing the player to fall through the map in Presidential Park
[*] The turnstile in the Presidential Square’s police station now blocks the player as intended.
[*] Fixed the issue where the music box in Presidential Square was erroneously referred to as a “pair of earrings” when playing the game in English.
[*] Several parts of the treasure hunt mini-game have been fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue affecting Stan & Mitch’s license plate texture
[*] Fixed an issue allowing Zoe to fly out of bounds in the ride “A taste of freedom”.
[*] Fixed an issue blocking the player from progressing after failing a certain QTE in the ride  “A taste of freedom”.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause Zoe to be misaligned during a laser section in the ride “Heist at the palace”
[*] Small changes to the credits
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the audio to echo when players used a headphone with certain audio compressed settings enabled.
[/list]
Rest assured, we are committed to further improving the game. If you come across any technical issues, please don't hesitate to contact our [url=https://playersupport.plaion.com/hc/en-us/categories/9479670683805-Road-96-Mile-0?utm_source=linktree&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=support][u][b]technical support team[/b][/u][/url]. We will do our utmost to assist you promptly.

Thank you all for your support and patience. We're grateful to have such an awesome community!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone,[/h2]

We want to thank all of you who left your feedback about Road 96: Mile 0. We're sorry to hear that some of you have experienced technical difficulties while playing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/cd0325493f6bb07a851b22246367a2cd60b95627.jpg[/img]

Our team is currently working hard to improve the game and gather all the valuable feedback that we've received. As part of our ongoing efforts, we are excited to release our first patch today, which aims to address the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing players from jumping during rides when the ingame FPS was higher than ~275. The game is now limited to 240fps. Players can still override that value by activating Vsync and using a screen that has a refresh rate higher than 240hz but we do not recommend players using it during rides as it might trigger the bug again.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing the player to enter Zoe's Room before discussing with Kaito in Oasis Villas
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the player to progress during the talkie walkie discussion in Hideout
[*] Fixed an issue blocking the player if a ride replay was triggered during an after ride hideout chapter
[*] Fixed a collider issue causing the player to fall through the map in Presidential Park 
[*] Removed John floating in the Hideout
[*] Added a game version canvas on the main menu
[/list]
[h4]E-book "Road 96: About A Girl" patch note:[/h4]

[list]
[*] Added epub versions for both English and French versions of the book
[*] Fixed Some localization issues
[*] Fixed some hyperlink issues preventing player from progressing
[/list]
We will continue doing our best to make the game better. If you encounter any technical issues, please do not hesitate to reach out to our technical support team, and we'll do our best to assist you.

notes.title: Road 96: Mile 0 is finally HERE!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Citizens of Petria,[/h2]

We have great news for you today! The much-awaited prequel to beloved [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466640/Road_96]Road 96[/url][/b] – Road 96: Mile 0 is finally HERE! 🛣️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/d41e29796f1df3fea8cf8b4afc76d61564a1f45e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Join Zoe and Kaito[/h3]

Embark with Zoe from [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466640/Road_96]Road 96[/url][/b] and Kaito from [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/509400/Lost_in_Harmony]Lost in Harmony[/url][/b] on their challenging adventure to uncover the truth behind the events happened in the past that Petria’s government is hiding.

These two teenagers have very different background and beliefs: [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2095340/announcements/detail/3681169040456500935]Zoe [/url][/b]is a daughter of the Minister of Oil and [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2095340/partnerevents/edit/3681169040463787953]Kaito [/url][/b]is a child from a far less privileged family, born in a bleak and polluted capital of Petria. Their past live and surrounding shaped their opinions on the situation in the country.

Their unexpected friendship will be put to the test as they navigate their journey in Road 96: Mile 0 and learn where they truly belong.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/541ddc641f4ef81a606a7bee0ac856e9a872135c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Character: Kaito
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Citizens of Petria,[/h2]

Now it is time to get to know Kaito. You may have encountered him in [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/509400/Lost_in_Harmony/]Lost in Harmony[/url][/b] previously. Kaito's story is one of resilience and strength in the face of adversity, and I believe you'll find it both inspiring and heart-wrenching.

[h3]Kaito’s Past [/h3]
Kaito is totally different from Zoe. He was born in Colton City, the polluted and dangerous capital of Petria.

His life was far from easy and happy. At just 15 he lost his girlfriend Aya to cancer caused by extreme pollution and a lack of proper healthcare for poor citizens. Three years have passed since then, but Kaito is still haunted by the traumatic memory, struggling to overcome and forget his past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/eee18c5c7cb38214783a82dda32ca9e36b50f53b.gif[/img]

[h3]Moving to White Sands[/h3]
In a run from pollution and poverty of Colton City, Kaito’s parents decided to move to the rich condominium – White Sands where the living conditions are significantly better. However, life in White Sands is still tough for Kaito's family, who are treated with contempt and have to do hard physical work to survive 

Will Kaito’s family be ready to cooperate with Black Brigades in hope to get help from them in return to secure their future? 🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/aee217419a7d87e514680dc85f363bc201e798f0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Friendship with Zoe[/h3]
Unlike other kids of White Sands, Kaito doesn’t go to school because he has to help his parents with work to survive. Within the 3 years of living in White Sands, Kaito didn’t make any friends except Zoe. Most of the free time Kaito spends on the construction site with Zoe listening to music and practicing skateboarding tricks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/18fc90cf67bf367ffaf9f9d90bb59c272ce263d4.png[/img]

[h3]Kaito's opinion[/h3]
Having had a hard life and a lot of traumatic experiences shaped his opinion on the government, which are quite depressive and very different from Zoe’s. The friendship of these two opposite teenagers will change their lives ultimately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/ce3d191ec5f423fd9f6247683d95f82201ab3915.png[/img]

So, hold on tight and get ready for a wild ride with Zoe and Kaito, two unforgettable characters from the world of Road 96: Mile 0.

notes.title: Character introduction: Zoe
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Citizens of Petria,[/h2]

Many of us already know Zoe from [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466640/Road_96/]Road 96[/url][/b]. She is one of the teenagers of Petria with a complicated faith.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/d7cc15c733551ec43f8803887f60e7a15c078021.gif[/img]

[h3]Zoe’s family[/h3]
Unlike most of the other citizens of Petria, Zoe was born into a very rich family of the Minister of Oil. Her wealthy upbringing has sheltered her from questioning the government's actions and she genuinely believed that they always had everyone's best interests at heart.

Despite her privilege, her life wasn’t as perfect as it looked. When Zoe was young, her mother unexpectedly left the family and her father controlled her every move with cameras placed all over the house.

All of this definitely left a deep impression on Zoe and her character that may seem too complicated and rebellious for an elite daughter as well as for the other citizens of Petria.

[h3]Meeting Kaito[/h3]
It was quite an unexpected coincidence that these two became friends. No one would have ever thought that one of the richest girls and a rebellious teenager from a poor family would find anything in common, but probably the reason is the rebellious spirit. Their friendship will change both of their lives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/9c8c462b144c7a18b45e494e5da636155124e59c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Mystery of the Trombone [/h3]
We see that many of you are particularly interested in a Trombone that Zoe always has next to her. She has it since her childhood. As other kids from well-off families played instruments, her father forced Zoe to choose an instrument as well. And… as you could guess, she chose the Trombone. 

The reason was nothing more than just to annoy her father with the splitting sound of her mastering this unique and loud instrument⚡️🎺

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/3f64ffbafc07b1d349c4347bf0b64a95e3487c1a.jpg[/img]

So, hold on tight and get ready for a wild ride with Zoe and Kaito, two unforgettable characters from the world of Road 96: Mile 0.

notes.title: Gameplay Insights
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We see that you are intrigued by the main gameplay of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095340/Road_96_Mile_0/]Road 96: Mile 0[/url]. So, we will be happy to shed some light on this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/69352e054e5fe7ac93fb6687ce2599cb34969a11.gif[/img]

[h3]Main Gameplay[/h3]
We know that many of you are worried that the Road 96 gameplay that you loved so much will be different in the prequel – Road 96: Mile 0. We have relieving news for you, Road 96: Mile 0 is still a [b]narrative adventure[/b] and the main gameplay is very similar to the one in Road 96. 

You will be able to discover the locations of White Sands with a first-person view, enjoy minigames, have dialogues and make choices that will determine the final ending in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39322286/aefb260566bf7c814317d696a43218f5b14621ea.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Mechanics[/h3]
A new feature in the gameplay is “Musical rides” – the skating journey that will allow you to better understand and feel the story of the characters and the world of Petria through a combination of visuals and music. It is not the main gameplay part, but it is still an important part of immersion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/89a63907bd539458e2d7cf54968d4cfc7031ba90.gif[/img]

The music is a vital part for all of us working on the game, so we do our best to choose the most fitting and touching sounds for you to truly experience and enjoy the game as much as possible! We hope that you will like the combination of the old and new mechanics ❤️

notes.title: Road 96 Universe is Back!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Citizens of Petria,[/h2]

We have great news for you today! We are excited to announce [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095340/Road_96_Mile_0]Road 96: Mile 0[/url] [/b]– a narrative adventure game with a musical component and a prequel to the events in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466640/Road_96]Road 96[/url]. The game will be released already this year, on [b]April 4th[/b]!

[i]This is the story about how it all started, the story that challenges your beliefs. [/i]

[previewyoutube=3fYO2XC33tQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Discover White Sands! [/h3]
The game scene takes place in the luxurious capital of Petria – [b]White Sands[/b]. You will be able to see for yourself how this community lives and what it stands for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/d09b68ee3be80fbfd61f35f6846a57980d91c3ea.png[/img]

[h3]Two teens, two worlds[/h3]
You will be able to take turns in the role of [b]Zoe [/b]from [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466640]Road 96[/url][/i], daughter of the Minister of Oil in Tyrak’s government, and [b]Kaito [/b]from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/509400/Lost_in_Harmony/][i]Lost in Harmony[/i][/url], who was born in a dangerous and depressive Colton city and moved to White Sands with his parents.

The development of their friendship will bring to light disturbing truths about Petria and the events happened in 1986 during the Border Attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546045/761bd417b149a3681f7bca0e98c1a09cb5b92624.gif[/img]

[h5][quote]"In Mile 0, we wanted to show where Zoe is coming from, and why she left her comfortable life. But we didn’t make it the conventional way, we went the crazy road, with metaphorical music sequences, where you ride the believes and doubts of Zoe and Kaito. The funny part is that YOU choose how you want them to evolve.”- [i]Yoan Fanise, Game Director.[/i] [/quote] [/h5]
We want to say thank you to [i][url=https://www.instagram.com/themidnightofficial/?hl=en]The Midnight[/url][/i] – the band that made it possible for us to enjoy the colourful and retro [i]Land Locked Heart[/i] ❤️
